# Write your MySQL query statement below
WITH
    t AS (
        SELECT
            visited_on,
            SUM(amount) OVER (
                ORDER BY visited_on
                ROWS 6 PRECEDING
            ) AS amount,
            RANK() OVER (
                ORDER BY visited_on
                ROWS 6 PRECEDING
            ) AS rk
        FROM
            (
                SELECT visited_on, SUM(amount) AS amount
                FROM Customer
                GROUP BY visited_on
            ) AS tt
    )
SELECT visited_on, amount, ROUND(amount / 7, 2) AS average_amount
FROM t
WHERE rk > 6;
